gaps.description: The landlord's conditional approval was requested for work described generally as post-tenancy work according to inspection instructions, while the £665 quote included carpet shampooing and garden tasks not listed in that approval request. Whether the conditional approval covered the full quoted scope is unclear.
The inspection note reports soil disturbed by digging, but the £665 quoted scope does not expressly say that making good the disturbed soil is included.
The landlord's update says “approved quote” but does not identify which quote, so its referent and applicable work scope are unresolved.
No visit was booked or confirmed; no firm date or confirmed contractor slot is recorded, and no maintenance completion date/update is recorded.

The inspection report states that rear-garden soil was disturbed by digging, while the quotation lists weeding, grass cutting and garden tidying. The attachment text does not establish whether that quoted work includes making good the disturbed soil.
